principle: Research changes experiment hypotheses and plugins only. Runtime changes require a separate Platform Lane release.
platform_defect_rule: If an experiment stops for runtime/import/spawn/resource-monitor/registry-entry infrastructure reasons, classify it as RUNTIME_DEFECT and move repair to Platform Lane. Do not patch runtime inside the research route.
research_result_rule: Model effect is owned by the route evaluation receipt. FFRUN never promotes alpha or research PASS from process exit alone.
